sources.title: Defense scores twice on Day 2
sources.description: WESTFIELD, Ind. — Indianapolis Colts Quarterback Daniel Jones sold the play-action before rolling right and looking to find tight end Tyler Warren in rhythm, but with defensive end Laiatu Latu chasing him down quickly, Jones released the pass just behind Warren, which allowed linebacker Austin Ajiake to undercut the throw and race the other way […]
